name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to publish (defaults to release tag)'
        required: false
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish-ppa:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: amd64
            distro: jammy
          - arch: arm64
            distro: jammy
          - arch: amd64
            distro: noble
          - arch: arm64
            distro: noble
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
        with:
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "release" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          elif [ "${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" != "" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          else
            VERSION="0.0.0-dev"
          fi
          # Strip leading 'v' if present
          VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build and Publish to PPA
        uses: ppas/actions-publish-ppa@v1
        with:
          command: debuild
          ppa: jdx/mise
          distribution: ${{ matrix.distro }}
          architecture: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          debdist: ${{ matrix.distro }}
          debarch: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          ssh-private-key: ${{ secrets.PPA_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          gpg-private-key: ${{ secrets.PPA_GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          gpg-passphrase: ${{ secrets.PPA_GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
          dput-config: ~/.pypirc
          build-args: |
            --no-sign
            -b
            -uc
            -us
